en.p: There is a triangle ABC inscribed in a circle of radius $2\sqrt{7}$ with $\angle\mathrm{A}=\dfrac{\pi}{3}$. For a point D on the arc BC not containing point A, when $\sin(\angle\mathrm{BCD})=\dfrac{2\sqrt{7}}{7}$, what is the value of $\overline{\mathrm{BD}}+\overline{\mathrm{CD}}$? [4 points]
